author: Kusha N M
raw:
ಸಂಕಲ್ಪ ಸಿದ್ಧಿಗಿವೆ ನೂರಾರು ದಾರಿಗಳು
ಶಂಕೆಗಳು ಪಥಿಕನನು ಕಾಡುವುದು ಸಹಜ
ಅಂಕೆಯಲ್ಲಿರಲುಮನ ಅನುಭವವೆ ಪರಿಹಾರ
ಅಂಕಣದೆ ಗೆಲುವಿಹುದು ಮೂಢಮನುಜ

lines: There are hundreds of ways to fulfil a resolve;
it is natural for doubts to trouble the traveller;
if the mind is kept in check, experience is the remedy;
victory lies in the arena, O deluded one.
en.bhavartha: There are many paths to any goal, and doubts are natural along the way. A disciplined mind and experience overcome them, and victory is won by staying in the field.
